svg.title: A growing bed has an outside
svg.desc: Three-dimensional growing-bed cutaway with crop leaves above mulch, branching roots in soil, a watering pipe, compost, and a harvested crate outside the bed. Sunlight and water enter; nutrients need replenishment, and harvested food carries nutrients away.
svg.text: A growing bed has an outside

g.text: Conceptual cutaway. Arrows are not quantities.
